title: Boss ka Boss group khaali!
format: Kitty Gang office role-play on the Office Vibes game: Ishita runs Housie like a Monday meeting and the four prize groups become office jokes

experiment.hook: Ishita as the boss on the Office Vibes home art, hands on hips, heartbeat at 0 s, mascot ball spinning above, chip 'AAJ KI MEETING: HOUSIE' pinned from the first frame, she says 'Meeting shuru! Laptop band, ticket kholo!'
experiment.variable: the world: everyday office life (boss, salary, meetings, the late colleague) played by the gang as a role-play, with the theme's prize groups as office jokes, instead of a festival moment or a home kitty scene
experiment.hypothesis: office jokes every working woman has lived (salary day, endless meetings, the boss who never wins) are more tag-able than festival moments: skip under 55% (best 48.9), watched % above 18 (best 18), at least 1 share from 'tag your office friend'

idea: Ishita plays boss and runs Housie like a Monday meeting. Shruti is thrilled Salary needs only 3 numbers, Myra cannot believe Meetings needs 5, Ruhi whispers that the boss's own Boss group is empty, and late Avika rushes in and completes Boss. Aditi closes: har office mein yahi hota hai.
beats: hook: meeting shuru, ticket kholo / esc 1: Shruti, salary jaldi, pehli baar / esc 2: Myra, paanch number Meetings? / call 52 Meetings done / esc 3: Ruhi whisper, Boss ka Boss group khaali / turn: Avika late, traffic / call 3, Avika completes Boss / button: Avika brag, Aditi deadpan
caption: Har office mein ek boss, ek late wali aur ek Aditi hoti hai. Apni office wali saheli ko tag karo! Aaj ki {theme} Housie mein Boss group kiska?

lines.text: Meeting shuru! Laptop band, ticket kholo!
lines.say: मीटिंग शुरू! लैपटॉप बंद, टिकट खोलो!

lines.text: Salary time pe aayi. Pehli baar!
lines.say: सैलरी टाइम पे आई। पहली बार!

lines.text: Paanch number Meetings? Yeh rule kab bana?
lines.say: पाँच नंबर मीटिंग्स? ये रूल कब बना?

lines.text: Psst! Boss ka Boss group khaali!
lines.say: श्श! बॉस का बॉस ग्रुप खाली!

lines.text: Late aayi, phir bhi Boss jeeta!
lines.say: लेट आई, फिर भी बॉस जीता!

lines.text: Hmm. Har office mein yahi hota hai.
lines.say: हम्म। हर ऑफिस में यही होता है।
